VR Game in Unity

Office Therapy

A VR comedy game where the "wellness program" involves corporate espionage, AI security robots, and blackmailing your boss.

About the Game

Be a better you, for us.

Office Therapy is a parody workplace wellness VR experience built in Unity. The premise is simple: you are a new employee at a suspiciously cheerful corporation, and your "wellness journey" involves planting surveillance cameras, stealing data off executive computers, navigating laser fields, and blackmailing your way to the top. The whole thing is narrated by an enthusiastic AI that genuinely believes this is good for you. It is a comedy game with a full corporate office environment, enemy AI, and a task system that keeps the chaos organized.
